svg.aria-label: Nova: a purple armored 3D robot who lives on your screen, does your work, and feels with you. 100% local, built with Python, Ollama, Whisper, three.js and Electron.

g.text: Armored 3D desktop companion | 100% local brain | Built by Hemashree
A purple armored 3D robot who lives on
your screen, does your work, and feels with you.
He talks, listens, remembers, flies around,
and cheers you up. Thinking happens on your
🦾 Armored 3D body, always on top of apps
👀 Glowing visor eyes for every mood
🐱 Pip the robo-kitty, loves head pats
💗 Reads your mood from words and voice
🎙️ Male neural voice that follows his mood
💻 Waves hello when your lid opens
opens a box to type in
Thinking happens on your PC. Nothing leaves it ✨
